safety_invariant: The CH-1 job runs on GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest, receives no VPS credentials, never mounts or addresses Production state, requires the Production container and /var/lib/matin-resume state to be absent, and runs the restored workload with --network none.
publication_rule: AC-1 persistent state advances only after the recovery artifact, DR-1, FH-1 and CH-1 evidence artifacts are all uploaded and validated; CH-1 must restore the same AC-1 generation on a GitHub-hosted runner separate from the Production VPS.
